hookSay: Bruno Fernandes's contract runs out in the summer. So how do Manchester United replace him?

story.name: Arda Güler
story.mapSay: The closest of them all: Arda Güler, at Real Madrid.
story.verdict: But would he leave Real Madrid for United? Very unlikely.

story.name: Paulo Dybala
story.verdict: Old and cheap, but still very like Bruno.

story.name: Rayan Cherki
story.lead: Then the next young option: Rayan Cherki, at Manchester City.
story.verdict: But we can't see City selling him to United.

story.name: Dani Olmo
story.lead: So who could United actually get? Dani Olmo, at Barcelona.
story.verdict: He's slipped out of favour, with Fermín López starting and playing well. Not the first choice, but a good fit, a fair price and the right age.

endSay: So: Güler is the dream, but Olmo is the realistic pick. Who would you sign? Follow for more.
